turns.sql:
WITH highest_dpi AS (
    SELECT d.District_ID, MAX(p.dpi) AS max_dpi
    FROM district d
    JOIN store_district sd ON d.District_ID = sd.District_ID
    JOIN store s ON sd.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY d.District_ID
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT d.District_ID,
           d.District_name,
           d.City_Area,
           p.product,
           p.dpi,
           p.pages_per_minute_color,
           p.interface
    FROM district d
    JOIN store_district sd ON d.District_ID = sd.District_ID
    JOIN store s ON sd.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    JOIN highest_dpi h ON d.District_ID = h.District_ID AND p.dpi = h.max_dpi
)
SELECT
    District_name,
    product,
    dpi,
    interface,
    SUM(pages_per_minute_color) OVER (PARTITION BY interface ORDER BY dpi DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_pages_per_minute,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY City_Area DESC) AS district_rank
FROM filtered
ORDER BY district_rank, interface, dpi DESC;

     max_products AS (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE pages_per_minute_color = (SELECT max_val FROM max_ppmc)),
